messages: It looks like #p107# in #m10000000# has prepared another round of training.

I saw #p107# again in #m10000000#. He said my training is still far from over and gave me a mission to hunt stronger monsters, farther from town. Once I finish this training, will I finally become a true adventurer?
I passed #p107#'s second training with flying colors! Once I reach Level 10, I'll be all set to choose my job!
name: Olaf's Second Training
